item.description: This folder covers the full order management lifecycle for the DemoShopping API. It includes requests for creating new orders, retrieving the orders list, updating item quantities and order totals, deleting orders, and viewing order history. Each operation is organized into its own sub-folder with corresponding success scenario requests.
